sources.beginner: Suite Petroleum Economics Studio (src/pages/apps/epe): the learner uploads the IKPOTO files and runs JV at 80 percent WI; ledger rows and KPIs at full precision only in the CSV/Excel export (EpeResultsViewer.jsx:1084-1127); on screen the ledger is fmtCompact (0.1M) and payback/take cards print 2/1 decimals. NextGen panels are AKATA-only (panelCapstoneGuard.test.js).
sources.intermediate: Suite Petroleum Economics Studio: two runs (end-year, mid-year) on the real basis; NPV/IRR/discounted payback/DPI/breakeven are KPIs exported raw in the Excel KPI sheet (EpeResultsViewer.jsx:1116); on screen IRR toFixed(2), discounted payback toFixed(2), DPI toFixed(2), breakeven toFixed(1).
sources.advanced: Fields 1-3 (price royalty, eligible bbl, CPR deferral) are never rendered or exported by the Suite (cashFlowColumns omits price_royalty, prod_alw_eligible_bbl, cpr_deferred_to_next) and are hand-calcs taught in advanced m02/l03, m03/l03, m03/l02; HCT total, 2033 levy and NPV come from the Petroleum Economics Studio CSV/Excel export.

fields.prompt_precision: found by bisection to the cent
fields.recommendation: Loosen tol to 0.005 (half a cent). The prompt frames the answer 'to the cent'; a learner who reports 66.10 misses by 0.00101 against tol 0.001. The engine's own bisection stops at a 0.001 bracket (cashflow.ts:1873), so its last digits are not meaningful either. Loosening never fails a current pass.
fields.evidence: Expected 66.101009; the prompt says 'to the cent' and 66.10 fails (|diff| 0.00101 > 0.001). On-screen card prints toFixed(1) = 66.1; Excel exports it raw.

Suite never renders or exports price_royalty (cashFlowColumns :80 has only the combined royalty). Hand-calc as taught: 2032 price 77.14, anchors 50 and 100 x 1.02^11, rate 0.05 x (77.14-62.169)/62.169 = 0.012041 on 0.8 x 1,280,000 x 77.14 of oil revenue = 951,123.18.
fields.notes: Honest as a hand-calc to full precision; the app gives no check on it (only royalty total less a production royalty the learner must also derive).

fields.evidence: Not rendered or exported by the Suite. 100,000,000 - 97,612,500 - 1,600,000 = 787,500 bbl, the cap arithmetic taught in m03/l03; integer quantity, tol 1.
